events.name: CLT_UPDATED
events.description: The sampling state after each draw — a composed listener (readout, grader) can subscribe; a harmless no-op when the atom runs standalone.
events.synonyms: sample drawn, means histogram, central limit theorem, sampling distribution

events.name: MODE_SELECTED
events.description: Lab router broadcast naming the active mode; this instrument renders when the mode equals matchMode, otherwise renders null.

events.name: SET_N
events.description: Learner dragged the sample-size slider — value is the new n; changing n clears the accumulated means.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Bins
overridableConfigKeys.description: Number of histogram buckets the sample means are counted into.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Draws Per Step
overridableConfigKeys.description: How many samples Draw Many adds to the means-histogram per click.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Match Mode
overridableConfigKeys.description: When composed behind a lab router, the MODE_SELECTED mode value this instrument responds to. Empty string means standalone — render immediately on INIT.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Population Kind
overridableConfigKeys.description: Shape of the population each sample is drawn from: uniform, skewed, or bimodal — the CLT normalizes the means-histogram regardless.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: population distribution, skewed distribution, bimodal, uniform distribution, sampling distribution, central limit theorem

overridableConfigKeys.label: Sample Size
overridableConfigKeys.description: Number of draws n per sample; larger n makes the means-histogram narrower and more normal.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: n, sample size, draws per sample

overridableConfigKeys.label: Show True Mean
overridableConfigKeys.description: Draw a marker line at the population mean.

overridableConfigKeys.label: True Mean
overridableConfigKeys.description: Population mean the sample means converge to; drawn as a marker line when Show True Mean is on.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Value Max
overridableConfigKeys.description: Population values range from 0 to this maximum.
